scope.eligibility: Every unique direct relation with observed status and at least one evidence identifier in the frozen reference.
scope.assignment: Sort eligible endpoint pairs by SHA-256 of '<reference_sha256>:<earlier>-><later>', then partition sequentially into groups of three; retain the final remainder.
scope.coverage: Each eligible relation appears in exactly one trial.

outcomes.primary: Paired difference in AURC between exact impact ranking and each control across trials where exact enumeration completes.
secondary: Exact, closure-gain, and sampled-order top-choice agreement
Exact order reduction and remaining chronological-order count
Sampled split R-hat, effective sample size, and chain top-choice consensus
outcomes.interpretation_limit: Results measure recovery of held-out reference implications, not archaeological importance, correctness probability, or fieldwork value.

settings.exact_truncation_policy: Record the trial as truncated and exclude it only from comparisons requiring exact AURC; retain all other strategy outcomes.
settings.random_seed_rule: 202609170000 + 100 * one-based trial number + zero-based repetition number
